name: Jersey — Public Service careers
authority: Government of Jersey — Jersey Public Service
notes: Government Jobs in Jersey page separates public-service portal from private-sector jobs. Sample Lecturer - Media Studies is permanent/full-time, closes 11 October 2026 date-only and requires candidate to be entitled for work. Residential/employment status, immigration permission and nationality are separate. Recruitment policy version 1.2 effective 27 March 2026 permits licensed recruitment only in limited circumstances; it does not guarantee sponsorship for every post. Lecturer criteria include level-two literacy/numeracy and fluent effective communication, without a named language or CEFR threshold. Work-permit policy Appendix 3 states English CEFR B1 across four skills for applicable routes, IELTS for UKVI 4.0 overall and each component, with exemptions/alternative proofs; this is immigration evidence, not a universal job-entry requirement.
